responsibility: Declares the central symbol-table and callgraph interfaces used by GCC IPA infrastructure. It defines the core node, edge, availability, partitioning, and section-name data structures for functions and variables, plus inline helpers for alias traversal, availability queries, polymorphic-call context objects, dump-string handling, and prevailing-symbol tests. This header is the shared contract that neighboring cgraph, symtab, IPA, cloning, thunk, and LTO code builds on.
same_name_distinction: Defines the central callgraph and symbol-table data structures, enums, declarations, and inline helpers that other IPA code includes. Unlike gcc/cgraph.cc, it does not own the mutable runtime algorithms and global state manipulation; it is the public contract for them.
